Sembra una frase detta per flexare. E invece no: è tutto vero. Tommaso Mazzanti, CEO e fondatore di All’Antico Vinaio, racconta che paga più di affitto in Via Orefici a Milano che a Beverly Hills. 🤯 Assurdo? Sì. Ma il punto è che ogni Paese ha le sue regole del gioco. In America magari spendi tantissimo per costruire il locale, sistemarlo, rifarlo da zero. In Italia, Francia e Spagna invece c’è un’altra cosa che pesa tantissimo: la buona uscita. E a volte parliamo di cifre fuori scala. A Bari, per esempio, Tommaso racconta di aver pagato quasi 700 mila euro solo per entrare in quel locale. 💸 Una follia? Probabile. Ma quando trovi il punto giusto, il locale giusto, la posizione giusta… a volte ti prendi anche il rischio. Perché fare impresa non è sempre prendere decisioni perfette. A volte è dire: “Mi piace. Ci credo. Lo faccio.” 🚀 E sì, ogni tanto qualche calzata la fai. Ma se hai visione, brand e prodotto, quella cazz*ta può diventare parte della storia. 👉 Guarda il video completo sul nostro canale YouTube per scoprire il resto della storia. #Chapeau #ceo #founder #AnticoVinaio #business

Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Chicken Au Poivre‼️ Full Video Things you need  Whole chicken Sherry Wine (Holland House Cooking Wine) 1 Large Shallot Minced Garlic (3-4 cloves) Heavy Whipping Cream, 2 - 2.5 cups Fresh Cracked Black Pepper Fresh Rosemary, chopped    Chicken Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Chili Powder, Paprika, Kinder’s Buttery Poultry Seasoning, Dried Parlsey  Sauce Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder Directions  1. Prepare the Chicken Clean the chicken using 1 part vinegar to 2 parts water. Remove the insides, then butterfly the chicken by cutting out the backbone with kitchen shears. Lay the chicken meat‑side up, pat dry, and press down firmly to flatten. Season generously with the listed seasonings, including salt and cracked black pepper on the underside. 2. Cook the Chicken Preheat the oven to 375°F. Heat a large skillet over medium‑high. Once hot, sear the whole chicken skin‑side down until browned, about 4–5 minutes per side. If cooking multiple chickens, repeat the process. Transfer the browned chicken(s) to a baking dish. Add about 1/3 cup water to the bottom of the dish, cover, and place in the oven while you prepare the sauce 3. Prepare the Sauce In the same skillet used for searing, add diced shallots, garlic, and chopped rosemary. Cook for 3–4 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the chicken. Deglaze with 1/2 cup Sherry cooking wine and cook for 2–3 minutes. Add 2 – 2.5 cups heavy whipping cream, whisking to combine. Season with the listed sauce seasonings and cook for 3–4 minutes, whisking occasionally. 4. Finish the Dish Remove the chicken from the oven and pour the cream sauce over the top. Return to the oven and cook for 60–90 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone. Baste the chicken with the cream sauce every 30 minutes, stirring the sauce before each baste. For reference: a 3–4 lb chicken typically cooks in about 1 hour and 20 minutes. 5. Serve Serve the chicken over mashed potatoes or rice, and garnish with parsley. #cookingvideos #chickenaupoivre #recipes #fyp #mashedpotatoes

They always ask why I didn’t make more | full recipe ⬇️ Smoked to perfection with @harmosgrill flavored pellets Serves: 6–8  Total Time: ~2–3 hours (including marinade) Ingredients Chicken 3–4 lbs bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (non-negotiable) 3–4 tbsp spicy brown mustard 2 tbsp Cuso’s Hot Honey Seasoning 2 tbsp Cuso’s Roasted Garlic & Onion Seasoning Grill / Smoke Harmos wood pellets: Spanish Barbecue Pirate & Turkish Barbecue Traveler Jalapeño Green Sauce 2–3 jalapeños (adjust for heat) 1 cup fresh cilantro 2–3 garlic cloves ½ cup Greek yogurt 2–3 tbsp olive oil Salt, to taste Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Marinate the Chicken Add chicken thighs to a large bowl. Coat fully with spicy brown mustard. Season generously with Cuso’s Hot Honey + Roasted Garlic & Onion seasoning. Mix until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least a few hours (overnight preferred). 2. Preheat the Grill Preheat your pellet grill to 350°F. Load with Harmos pellets (Spanish Barbecue Pirate + Turkish Barbecue Traveler) for deep smoky flavor with paprika, garlic, rosemary, and spice notes. 3. Make the Jalapeño Green Sauce Add jalapeños, cilantro, garlic, Greek yogurt, olive oil, salt, and pepper to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning or heat. Chill until ready to serve. 4. Smoke the Chicken Place chicken directly on the grill grates. Cook for about 1 hour, until internal temp reaches 160°F. 5. Crank the Heat Increase grill temp to 500°F. Cook until chicken hits 180°F internal and skin gets crispy with great color. 6. Serve Remove from grill and rest a few minutes. Serve with the jalapeño green sauce on the side or drizzled over top. #HarmosGrill  #HarmosWoodPellets  #HarmosFlavoredPellets

GRILLED CHICKEN + RICE + BROCCOLI 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken breast • 200 g cooked white rice • 200 g broccoli • 2 tbsp olive oil • Salt & pepper 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Season chicken with salt & pepper Grill until fully cooked and juicy Steam broccoli until tender Serve with rice and portion into containers 🍱 2. TERIYAKI CHICKEN + RICE + SESAME 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken • 3 tbsp teriyaki sauce • 200 g cooked rice • 1 tbsp sesame seeds 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Cook chicken until browned Add teriyaki sauce and let it glaze Serve over rice and top with sesame seeds 🍝 3. CREAMY CHICKEN PASTA 🛒 Ingredients: • 300 g chicken • 200 g pasta • 200 ml heavy cream • 2 garlic cloves • 50 g parmesan cheese • Salt & pepper 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Cook pasta and set aside Sauté chicken with garlic Add cream + parmesan → make sauce Toss with pasta and portion 🥡 4. CHICKEN STIR-FRY + VEGETABLES + RICE 🛒 Ingredients: • 300 g chicken • 200 g cooked rice • 200 g mixed vegetables • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1 tbsp oil • 2 garlic cloves 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Stir-fry chicken with garlic Add vegetables + soy sauce Cook until glossy and coated Serve with rice 🌿 5. BAKED HERB CHICKEN + POTATOES + CARROTS 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken • 300 g potatoes • 150 g carrots • 2 tbsp olive oil • Oregano or parsley • Salt & pepper 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Season everything with oil + herbs Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25–30 min Cook until golden and tender Divide into containers 🌶 6. SPICY CHICKEN + RICE + CORN 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken • 1 tsp paprika • ½ tsp chili flakes • 200 g cooked rice • 150 g corn • 2 tbsp oil 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Season chicken with spices Cook until golden & slightly crispy Serve with rice and corn 🥗 7. CHICKEN + MASHED POTATOES + GREEN BEANS 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken • 300 g potatoes • 150 g green beans • 50 ml milk • 2 tbsp butter • Salt & pepper 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Boil potatoes → mash with milk + butter Cook chicken until juicy Sauté green beans Serve together and portion ⏱️ MEAL PREP TIP 🔥 ✔ Store in fridge 3–4 days ✔ Reheat when ready ✔ Keep sauces separate for best texture #MealPrep #HighProteinMeals #ChickenRecipes #HealthyEating

One Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken Bake🔥410 cals 37g protein 11g fat 40g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 meals 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 ½ cups jasmine rice, uncooked 3 cups chicken broth, warmed 1 medium yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 1 ½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved 2 cups baby spinach, roughly chopped 4 cloves garlic, minced 50g freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 tsp Italian seasoning 1 ½ tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ¾ tsp smoked paprika ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) ¼ cup fresh parsley, finely chopped Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F 2. Add chicken thigh, 1 ½ cups uncooked rice, diced onion, red bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, spinach, and minced garlic directly to the baking dish. 3. Season with 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 ½ tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ¾ tsp smoked paprika, ¾ tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, and red pepper flakes if using. 4. Pour in 3 cups chicken broth and stir everything together until evenly combined and the rice is submerged. 5. Cover the baking dish tightly with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes. 6. Remove the foil and add fresh parm and go back in the oven uncovered for another 15 mins at 400° 7. Finish with the remaining fresh parsley  Serve hot and enjoy! One-Pan Chicken & Rice aka Arroz con Pollo 🥘 @HexClad @Goya Foods @Kerrygold USA @getgraza  Ingredients * 2–3 lbs chicken thighs * 2 cups rice * 4 cups chicken broth or water * 1 red bell pepper, diced * ½ medium onion, diced * ½ cup carrots, diced * 4 garlic cloves, minced * 2–3 tbsp butter * Olive oil * 1-2 tbsp chicken bouillon * Salt, to taste * Fresh cilantro, for garnish * Paprika * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Goya Adobo seasoning Instructions 1. Dice the red bell pepper, onion, and carrots, and mince the garlic. 2. Season both sides of the chicken thighs with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and Goya Adobo. 3. Heat a little olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Sear the chicken thighs for about 4 minutes per side, or until they develop a beautiful golden crust. Remove the chicken and set aside. 4. In the same pan, add the bell pepper, onion, carrots, and garlic. Add 2–3 tablespoons of butter and sauté for a few minutes, until fragrant. 5. Add 2 cups of rice and sauté it with the vegetables for another 1–2 minutes. 6. Pour in 4 cups of chicken broth (or water) and stir in chicken bouillon. Taste the liquid and add salt or more chicken bouillon if needed. 7. Nestle the chicken thighs back on top of the rice. Pour in any juices that collected on the plate—don’t waste that flavor! 8. Cover and cook over medium-low heat for about 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken is fully cooked (165°F internally). 9. Turn off the heat and leave the pan covered for another 5–10 minutes before serving. 10. Finish with fresh cilantro and serve. #chickenandrice #EasyRecipe #mealprep #arrozconpollo #DinnerIdeas

“Da piccolo volevo fare il casellante” Maurizio Ughi, Fondatore di SNAI, non ha mai inseguito il classico sogno da imprenditore. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

I realized I never gave ya’ll the recipe to my BigBrownieChunks or bbc recipe so…here ya go! So gooey!  🍫Pan: 8×8-inch light metal pan Oven: 350°F Ingredients: * 1 cup (226 g) unsalted butter * 1⅓ cups (120 g) Dutch-processed cocoa powder * 1 teaspoon fine sea salt * 2½ cups powdered sugar * ½ cup light brown sugar * 3 large eggs, room temperature * 1 additional egg yolk, room temperature * 3 teaspoons vanilla extract * 1 cup (120 g) all-purpose flour * 1½ cups (280 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips * ½ cup chopped semi-sweet chocolate bar * Powdered sugar, for finishing Step-by-Step 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line an 8×8-inch light metal pan with parchment paper. 2. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Continue cooking, stirring frequently, until it becomes golden brown, smells nutty, and you can see browned milk solids at the bottom. 3. Add the cocoa powder and salt to a heat safe bowl. Immediately pour the hot browned butter over the cocoa and whisk or stir until completely smooth and glossy. Let cool until warm, not hot. 4. Whisk the sugars & eggs for that crackle top! In a separate large bowl, combine the powdered sugar, brown sugar, 3 eggs, and additional egg yolk. Whisk HARD for 60–90 seconds, until the mixture looks lighter, thick, glossy, and well combined. 5. Stir the vanilla into the warm cocoa butter mixture. Pour the cocoa mixture into the egg & sugar mixture and whisk until the batter is thick, dark, smooth, and shiny. 6. Gently fold in the flour just until the last dry streak disappears. Do not overmix. 7. Reserve 1/4 cup of batter for extra crackle top! set it aside. 8. Gently fold 1½ cups semi-sweet chocolate chips into the remaining batter. Spread the chocolate-chip brownie batter evenly into the prepared pan. 9. Make the smooth crackle layer Take the reserved ¼ cup of chip-free batter and spread it very thinly over the surface. 10. Sprinkle the ½ cup chopped semi-sweet chocolate bar over the top. These will melt into gooey chocolate pockets. 11. Bake at 350°F for 28–35 minutes. Don’t wait for a completely clean toothpick! the brownies are supposed to stay molten and fudgy inside. 12. Let the brownies cool completely in the pan before lifting them out. #brownies #brownierecipe #molten #chocolate

videos.caption: Notice the GarlicDalek T did you? 😏😂 Follow the link in my bio for the link 💪❤️ HIGH PROTEIN HONEY GARLIC BUTTER CHICKEN MAC & CHEESE 9.5/10 — bloody lovely. 😂 Creamy, cheesy mac & cheese with sticky honey garlic chicken. Absolute filth, but somehow still 59g of protein per serving. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. MACROS PER SERVING: 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat SERVINGS: 4 Cheers: @jalalsamfit

Hot Honey Chipotle Chicken Tostadas🍯🍗🔥 #foodtok #easyrecipes #foodreview #recipehack #weeknightmeals  Recipe:  For the Chicken: * 2–3 chicken breasts, diced into small pieces * 2 tbsp mayonnaise * 1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced * 1 tbsp adobo sauce * Avocado oil * Garlic powder * Cumin * Paprika * Chipotle seasoning * Salt & pepper to taste * Juice of 1 lime * Honey or hot honey, to taste For the Guacamole: * 2–3 avocados * Diced Roma tomato * Diced red onion * Salt & pepper to taste * Juice of 1 lime * Chopped cilantro For the Pico de Gallo: * Diced Roma tomatoes * Diced red onion * Chopped cilantro * Salt & pepper to taste * Juice of ½ lime For the Chipotle Sauce: * Mayonnaise * 1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce * Paprika * 1–2 garlic cloves, minced * Salt & pepper to taste * Juice of ½ lime For Serving: * Tostada shells Instructions 1. Start by dicing your chicken breasts into small bite-sized pieces. Add to a bowl with mayonnaise, minced chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, avocado oil, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, chipotle seasoning, salt, pepper, and the juice of one lime. Mix well until everything is coated. Cover and marinate for at least 1 hour, or longer for even more flavor. 2. While your chicken marinates, prepare your guacamole. Add your avocados, diced Roma tomato, red onion, salt, pepper, lime juice, and cilantro to a bowl. Mash everything together until you reach your desired consistency. 3. For the pico de gallo, combine diced tomatoes, red onion, cilantro, salt, pepper, and the juice of ½ lime. Mix well and set aside. 4. Next, make your chipotle sauce. In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, paprika, minced garlic, salt, pepper, and lime juice. Mix until smooth and creamy. 5. Heat a drizzle of avocado oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add your marinated chicken and sear until golden brown and fully cooked. 6. Drizzle your chicken with honey or hot honey, depending on how much heat you like. Reduce the heat to a simmer and toss until the honey slightly thickens and coats the chicken. This usually takes about 1 minute. 7. To assemble, spread a generous layer of guacamole over your tostada shells, add your fresh pico de gallo, pile on that hot honey chicken, and finish with a drizzle of your homemade chipotle sauce.

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

This is my new favourite high-protein comfort meal 🤤 Think chukauni… but with juicy golden chicken, smoky mustard oil tadka, garlic-y curd, and those Nepali-style flavours that just hit different. It’s rich, tangy, spicy, creamy — and honestly perfect with soft rotis or steaming hot rice. Nepali Style Chicken Chukauni  🥣 Serves: 3 🔥 Macros (per serving): Calories: 374 kcal | Protein: 38 g | Carbs: 2.7 g | Fat: 22.3 g Ingredients For the Chicken 	•	400 g boneless chicken thigh (or breast), cut into small cubes 	•	2 tsp ginger-garlic paste 	•	½ tsp salt 	•	½ tsp pepper 	•	1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder 	•	½ tsp turmeric powder 	•	1 tsp lemon juice 	•	Light brush or spray of oil for frying For the Mix 	•	1 small onion, thinly sliced 	•	1–2 green chilies, chopped 	•	3 tbsp fresh coriander leaves, chopped (divided) For the Yogurt Base 	•	1 cup thick curd (I used Amul High-Protein Curd) or Greek yogurt  	•	1 tsp garlic paste 	•	½ tsp salt 	•	½ tsp sugar For the Tadka 	•	1.5 tbsp mustard oil 	•	½ tsp turmeric powder 	•	1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder 	•	1 tsp kasuri methi, crushed Method 1️⃣ Mix chicken with ginger-garlic paste, salt, pepper, Kashmiri chili powder, turmeric, and lemon juice. Rest 10–15 minutes. 2️⃣ Brush or spray a pan with very little oil. Pan-fry chicken on medium-high until golden brown. Transfer to a bowl. 3️⃣ Add sliced onion, chopped chilies, and half the coriander. Mix well and set aside. 4️⃣ In another bowl, whisk thick curd with garlic paste, salt, and sugar until smooth and creamy. 5️⃣ Heat mustard oil until smoking hot. Turn off the heat, add turmeric, Kashmiri chili powder, and crushed kasuri methi. 6️⃣ Pour the hot tadka into the curd and swirl gently to keep the streaks. 7️⃣ Pour the yogurt mixture over the chicken mixture. Mix gently. Finish with more chopped coriander leaves. Enjoy with soft rotis or steaming hot rice. . (chicken chukauni, Nepali chicken recipe, high protein Indian recipes, yogurt chicken salad, chicken curry, easy dinner, healthy chicken dinner, chukauni recipe) . #HealthyRecipes #NepaliFood #IndianCooking #ComfortFood #EasyDinners

Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 serving (1 meal prep): Protein: 47g Carbs: 78g Fat: 13g Calories: 616 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 14oz chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 3 tbsp cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil Honey Soy Glaze - 2 tbsp soy sauce - 3/4 tbsp oyster sauce - 2 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic - 1/2 tbsp minced ginger Korean Cucumber Kimchi Salad - 3 Persian cucumbers, whole, medium - 1/4 tbsp salt - 1/2 tbsp rice vinegar - 1/2 tbsp minced garlic - 1/2 tbsp sesame oil - 1 tbsp gochugaru - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1/2 tbsp brown sugar - 1 tsp sesame seeds Rice (and topping) - 1.25 cup cooked rice (white or brown) - 2 green onions, medium - 1 tsp sesame seeds How to make it yourself: 1. Cut your cucumbers into 1 inch pieces and crush them with a mallet 2. In a bowl, add your cucumbers and salt and set aside for 10 minutes. 3. Drain all excess liquid, rise your cucumbers with water, pat them dry with a paper towel, and in a new bowl add rice vinegar, minced, garlic, sesame oil, sesame seeds, soy sauce, brown sugar, and gochugaru and mix well to make your spicy cucumber kimchi 4. Season your chicken evenly with salt, pepper, and cornstarch 5. In a bowl, mix together soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, minced garlic, and minced ginger to make your glaze 6. In a pan on medium hear coated with spray oil, cook your chicken until golden brown, then flip and cook until both sides are golden brown with a crispy crust 7. Lower the heat to low and pour your glaze on top of the chicken and let it sit for 1 minute 8. In a meal prep container, add half your cooked rice, half your chicken, half your cucumber kimchi salad, and top it off with sesame seeds and diced green onions and enjoy! 📩 Save this Crispy Asian Soy Glazed Chicken Meal Prep recipe to make for later and if you make it, post it and tag me in it! Sprout is Fauna Robotics’ small, developer-focused humanoid robot built to work safely around people in real-world spaces like labs, schools, offices, retail, and entertainment venues. It’s designed less like a shrunken factory robot and more like a “human-environment” platform: lightweight, padded/soft on the outside, and engineered to reduce impact risk with compliant control and limited joint torques. What makes Sprout interesting is the “full-stack” approach. Fauna positions it as a ready-to-build-on system where core capabilities—movement, perception, navigation, and social expression—work out of the box, so teams can spend time on applications instead of rebuilding fundamentals.  Sprout also leans into interaction: it can be directed via voice, has expressive features (like articulated eyebrows and LED facial elements), and supports things like whole-body control, grippers for manipulation, and even VR-based teleoperation within a unified hardware-software stack.  Pricing reported at launch is about $50,000, targeting researchers, universities, and builders who want a capable humanoid platform without starting from scratch.#ainews #robotics #Techtok #futuretech

EASY RECIPE BELOW👇😋 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐲 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 & 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞  …this one is PURE comfort food & so easy 🥹🍗🍚 the sauce is rich, herby, a little spice, and so good poured over fluffy rice!!🤍✨ ⸻ 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧: • 2 lbs chicken thighs or breasts • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞: • 2 tbsp butter • 1 small onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 2 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional to make it thicker) 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞: • 1½ cups long-grain white rice • 3 cups water or chicken broth ⸻  𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:  1. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Sweet & Sticky Chicken 🍯🌶️ Easy high-protein meal prep that tastes ridiculously good and makes 8 big serves. Ingredients * 2 kg chicken thighs, diced * 1 kg cooked jasmine rice * 150 ml sweet chilli sauce * 100 ml honey * 100 ml soy sauce * Garlic powder * Smoked paprika * Spring onions Method 1. Season the chicken with garlic powder and smoked paprika, then cook until browned and cooked through. 2. Add the sweet chilli sauce, honey and soy sauce. 3. Cook everything down until the sauce becomes thick and sticky. 4. Divide the rice and sweet & sticky chicken between 8 containers. 5. Finish with sliced spring onions. ✨ Want a stunning, weed-free flower bed? Try this easy "pot-in-pot" landscaping hack to keep your borders looking fresh all year long! 📦 First, lay down cardboard along your path and space out heavy-duty black base pots on top. The cardboard acts as an amazing, natural weed barrier. 💧 Next, pour gravel all around the base pots. This hides the cardboard, holds your base pots securely in place, and provides excellent water drainage. 🪴 Now just drop your decorative plants-still in their own nursery pots-directly into the base pots! You can swap them out in seconds when seasons change or easily lift them inside if a freeze hits. 💡 Pro-tips: Mix up your flower colors, put the taller plants in the back, and always match your plants to the amount of sunlight that wall gets.

Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers!!!  Tender chicken coated in a honey garlic soy sauce with sautéed peppers. Sticky, savory, and perfect over rice!!!  Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers  2 large chicken breast  Neutral oil  1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp soy 1/2 tsp onion powder  1 tsp cornstarch  Sauce  Bell peppers, sliced (for sautéing) 1 tsp ginger paste or grated  2 tbsp garlic paste  2 tbsp honey  1/4 cup light and dark soy combined  1 tsp rice seasoning  1 tbsp hoisin sauce  1/2 tbsp oyster sauce  1/2 tsp Totole Granulated Chicken Flavor Season the chicken with neutral oil, seasonings, and cornstarch. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Cook the chicken in a skillet 2–3 minutes per side until lightly browned, then remove and set aside. In the same pan, sauté the sliced peppers until they reach your desired texture, then add the garlic paste. Pour in the sauce and simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. If needed, add a 1:1 cornstarch slurry to thicken. Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together until coated. Garnish with sliced green onions and enjoy #Foodie #cooking #food #honeygarlicchicken #chicken

Replying to @Just a shifter!<3  Welcome to my fall soup series 🍲🍁🍂 Below is the recipe to this DELICIOUS marry me chicken gnocchi soup 🤭  Ingredients:  Chicken Breasts 1 tsp Salt Pepper 1 1/2 tsp Garlic Powder 1 tsp Onion Powder 2 tbsp Paprika 1 tsp Chilli Powder 1 tsp Slap ya mama seasoning 1/2 tsp Cayenne pepper  1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tbsp Adobo sauce  3 cups Low Sodium Chicken Broth 1 1/2 cup Heavy Cream 2 cups Parmesean cheese  Basil 1/2 White onion 1 tbsp Minced garlic  3 tbsp Olive Oil Cherry tomatoes  Gnocchi  Instructions: 1. To a bowl pour in olive oil, adobo sauce, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, chilli powder, paprika. Mix, add in chicken breast and incorporate. Set aside for 30 mins 2. Cook chicken breast on medium heat until slightly charred, set aside, and shred once slightly cooled down.  3. In the same pot, add in diced onions, minced garlic, cherry tomatoes, and basil. Let cook until tomatoes are soft and then lightly mash them with spoon.  4. Pour in chicken broth and let boil before adding in gnocchi and let cook for about 4 minutes.  5. Pour in heavy cream and season with salt, onion powder, garlic powder, chilli powder, slap ya mama seasoning, cayenne powder, pepper, and paprika.  6. Allow to boil and pour in parmesean cheese. Mix well and let cook for about 2 minutes.  7. Pour in shredded chicken, mix well and add basil. Cover pot and let cook on low heat for about 5 minutes  8. Serve garnished with Parmesan cheese and basil, and enjoy :) #marrymechicken #gnocchi #soup #fallsoup #foodcreator
